_comment: NIMBY overrides for the mission's cfggameplay.json (decided 2026-10-14).
Apply onto the STOCK cfggameplay.json of the active mission; never copy a whole file between maps,
because temperatures and other world values are map-specific. Keys not listed stay at Bohemia's values.
serverDZ.cfg must keep enableCfgGameplayFile = 1, or none of this loads.
